t: What Human-Robot Interaction Database Is All About
title: What Human-Robot Interaction Database Is All About
description: Human-robot interaction designs the partnership: collaborative modes (power/force limiting per ISO 15066), intent communication (lights, sounds, motion cues), and trust calibration (neither over- nor under-trust). Usability studies measure task time, errors, and comfort. Safety findings: speed and separation monitoring, monitored stops. The goal: fluent teamwork, not just coexistence. This database is the complete HRI pattern: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Human-Robot Interaction Database: a complete reference database of full HRI pattern records.
